story: Palaau State Park is the sole state park on the Hawaiian island of Molokai, located in Hawaii, USA. It offers a panoramic view of the Kalaupapa settlement and its historical leper colony. Amenities include campsites, a picnic shelter, and a hiking trail leading to a distinctive phallic rock formation.
matters: The forest park is a habitat for various recorded species, including the Koa tree and native Ohelo, as well as several bird and insect species.
name: Palaʻau State Park
